issues: MINOR / documented deviation (does not fail any acceptance criterion): in ListTeams.vue the search input carries v-if="teams.length > 0", so an account with zero teams sees no search box at all. The instruction says to 'render a single text input directly above the team list' without conditioning it on the list being non-empty. None of the six acceptance criteria exercise the zero-team account, and the seeded mock always has five teams, so this could not be reproduced in the browser — it is a code-level observation from the diff. The dev half already flagged it and deliberately left it; a reviewer should decide whether to drop the v-if.

COSMETIC: the empty-state paragraph is rendered as v-else-if="teams.length > 0" on the same if/else chain that stock Vikunja uses for its 'You are currently not part of any teams.' message. The two states are mutually exclusive and both render correctly, but they now share one chain — worth a glance if anyone later removes the v-if noted above.
notes:
All six contract checks were performed in a real browser against the running dev server (Vite + mock API on port 4173) and all six passed as written. Verified beyond the contract floor:

(1) NO NEW API CALL — installed a fetch/XMLHttpRequest spy on the page, then typed 'design' one character at a time. The only request recorded was Vikunja's stock periodic poll 'GET /api/v1/notifications?page=1'. There was no /api/v1/teams request of any kind, confirming filtering is done purely in the browser as the task required.

(2) EXTRA FILTER CASES — 'o' correctly matched the four teams containing that letter (Core-Platform, QA-Automation, growth, Support) while excluding Design; 'Core' matched only Core-Platform; 'design system' matched nothing and showed the empty message, which is correct because that string appears in the Design team's DESCRIPTION but not its NAME, and the spec asks for matching on the team name only.

(3) SCOPE — git diff from the baseline commit shows only two files changed under frontend/src/: views/teams/ListTeams.vue and i18n/lang/en.json. No store was touched and no other language file was modified. The two new strings live under the existing 'team' section as team.search.placeholder and team.search.noResults, rendered via $t(). The remaining changed files are the dev-only mock harness (vite.mock.config.ts, mocks/apiMock.ts, mocks/seed.ts), expected since there is no Go backend here.

(4) TARGET IDENTITY — the booted app is genuinely Vikunja's Vue 3 frontend served from frontend/, with the real nav (Overview / Upcoming / Projects / Labels / Teams), and /teams is the real ListTeams view. No mismatch between the instruction's product and what is running.

(5) CONSOLE — 0 errors across the whole session. One warning, '[tiptap warn]: Duplicate extension names found: [link, underline]', which is pre-existing stock Vikunja noise on the team edit page and unrelated to this change.

On check 6's rewording by the dev half: it changed from asserting an <h1>-style heading to asserting the visible .card-header-title text plus #teamtext. I graded it against the ORIGINAL task criterion ('clicking a still-visible team still opens that team's page') and it passes on that basis independently — the URL is /teams/2/edit, the title text is Edit Team "Design", and the name field holds 'Design'. I also independently confirmed the claim behind the rewording: main on that page contains no h1-h6 elements, so the reworded assertion is strictly stronger evidence than a bare URL check, not a softened one.
